description: Defines the Stream class implementing StreamInterface for handling data streams, including reading, writing, seeking, and metadata operations within the ZipStream namespace.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: A class that wraps a PHP stream resource, providing common stream operations such as read, write, seek, and metadata access.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Reads all data from the stream into a string, seeking to the beginning first.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream and releases resources.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying PHP stream resource.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is seekable.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stream metadata or a specific key.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream pointer.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at end-of-file.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Seeks to the beginning of the stream.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns remaining contents of the stream.
